title: Learn Hip Hop Dance in 5 Minutes - CABBAGE PATCH (easy to follow)

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down the dance step-by-step using clear verbal instructions combined with slow demonstrations. He uses casual, encouraging language while focusing on hand and torso coordination.
